name: Strain Creation API
author: Ben
summary: Library that lets mods add strains - run modifiers you pick before a run. Adds a MOD STRAINS picker and 'strain' console commands.
description:
Not much to look at on its own - install it because a strain mod asked for it. It lets mods add their own strains: rules you choose before a run, like the game's own No Queen or Tile Exhauster, that hold for the whole run.

Modded strains sit next to the vanilla ones rather than inside the game's strain screen. Pick them from the MOD STRAINS button on the home screen, next to Settings; your picks apply from your next run, and a run keeps the strains it started with through quitting and continuing, until you start another one.

It also adds console commands (F10): `strain` shows what is picked and what is on the run in progress, then `strain list`, `strain info <id>`, `strain on <id>`, `strain off <id|all>`, `strain apply <id>` and `strain remove <id>` (put a strain on the current run, or take it off, right now) and `strain picker`.
